paths.name: Path of Dread
paths.description: A mastery path focused on offense

ability.name: Chaotic Advantage
ability.description: Any time you parry an attack, you will regain 75 Action Points. Tactic can not trigger more than once every 3 seconds.

ability.name: Dreadful Terror
ability.note: May only use three Chaotic Auras at a time
ability.description: The power of the Warp encases you in a terrifying visage. All enemies within 25 feet will lose 20 Action Points every 5 seconds. All groupmates within 100 feet will regain 20 Action Points every 5 seconds.

ability.name: Oppressing Blows
ability.description: Increases your chance to critically hit by 15% when you are wielding a Greatweapon and causes Relentless to inflict Spirit damage.

ability.name: Relentless
ability.description: You hack at your enemy with brutal strikes for up to 3 seconds, striking them up to six times and dealing 208 damage with each hit.  This effect will end if you break your concentration or run out of action points. The final strike deals 25% more damage for each active Aura of Dread.

ability.name: Daemonclaw
ability.description: Whenever you parry an attack, your Strength and Toughness will be increased by 160 for 10 seconds. This effect will not refresh itself.

ability.name: Rending Blade
ability.description: Your Demonic blade overpowers your enemy's defense causing 184 Spirit damage to all enemies within 25 feet in front of you. This attack is undefendable. The cooldown of Rending Blade is reduced by 1 second for each active Aura of Dread.

ability.name: Warping Embrace
ability.description: A surge of chaotic energy ripples forward inflicting 1800 damage over 10 seconds to everyone 40 feet in front of you. The surge of power clings to its victims, snaring them by 30% for 10 seconds.

coreAbilities.name: Dreadful Fear
coreAbilities.note: May only use three Chaotic Auras at a time
coreAbilities.description: You call upon the power of the warp to instill a bone chilling fear in your opponents within 25 feet of you, reducing their Strength by 100. During this time, the Strength of any groupmates within 100 feet is increased by 100.

coreAbilities.name: Withering Blow
coreAbilities.description: You release chaotic energies through your blade, withering your opponent's limbs causing 171 damage and snares your target, reducing their movement speed by 40% for 10 seconds. If you have an active Aura of Dread, you deal an additional 228 damage over 10 seconds.

coreAbilities.name: Tooth of Tzeentch
coreAbilities.description: You stab into your opponent for 209 damage.  For the next 5 seconds, Tooth Of Tzeentch will cause an additional 150 Spirit damage on the next damaging attack made by everyone in your group within 100 feet of you.

coreAbilities.name: Cleave
coreAbilities.description: A powerful overhand blow that inflicts 209 damage and can not be defended against.

coreAbilities.name: Dreadful Agony
coreAbilities.note: May only use three Chaotic Auras at a time
coreAbilities.description: You call on the power of the Warp, channeling warped energy in to the hearts and minds of your opponents. All enemies within 25 feet will take 148 Spirit damage every 3 seconds.

coreAbilities.name: Suppression
coreAbilities.description: A quick blow that causes 171 damage and improves your defensive position, increasing your chance to parry by  20% for 20 seconds.

paths.name: Path of Corruption
paths.description: A mastery path focused on counters and defense

ability.name: Dire Shielding
ability.description: Bane Shield will now also protect any of your groupmates within 30 feet and last 7 seconds longer.

ability.name: Corrupting Horror
ability.note: May only use three Chaotic Auras at a time
ability.description: The power of the Warp radiates out from you, placing horrifying visions inside the heads of all foes within 25 feet, causing their spells to build up 25% slower.

ability.name: Corruptive Power
ability.description: Any time you critically hit an enemy, all members of your group within 100 feet except you will gain an enchantment that reduces their chance to be critically hit by 10% for 5 seconds.

ability.name: Downfall
ability.description: A fierce blow that knocks down your opponent for 3 seconds and inflicts 209 damage. The chance of Downfall being defended by the enemy is reduced by 10% for each active Aura of Corruption.

ability.name: Mixed Defenses
ability.description: Any time you block an attack, your chance to parry is increased by 25% for 5 seconds.

ability.name: Oppression
ability.description: A thunderous shield slam that inflicts 246 damage, increases your armor by 594 for 20 seconds and reduces your damage taken by 15% for 10 seconds. Additionally reduces damage taken by group members within 100ft by 15% for 5 seconds. Durations are increased by 2 seconds for each active Aura of Corruption.

ability.name: Sprout Carapace
ability.description: In a chaotic surge of growth, everyone in the group's skin hardens, increasing Armor by 1320 and all Resists by 480 for 30 seconds. Everyone receives 100 AP as well.

coreAbilities.name: Enraged Blow
coreAbilities.description: A powerful blow that does 171 damage and has significantly increased threat against monsters

coreAbilities.name: Corrupting Wrath
coreAbilities.note: May only use three Chaotic Auras at a time
coreAbilities.description: You call upon the power of the warp to wither your opponents' mind and muscles, reducing the Toughness of all enemies within 25 feet by 100. During this time, group members within 100 feet are emboldened, increasing their Toughness by 100.

coreAbilities.name: Dizzying Blow
coreAbilities.description: A blow to the head which inflicts 171 damage and removes 30 Action Points.

coreAbilities.name: Corrupting Retribution
coreAbilities.note: May only use three Chaotic Auras at a time
coreAbilities.description: You instill the power of the warp in your groupmates within 100 feet, causing their corrupted power to regenerate flesh and bone, healing them for 180 health over 3 seconds every time they defend an attack.

coreAbilities.name: Repel
coreAbilities.description: Forceful blow that deals 209 damage and knocks back players and knocks down monsters.

coreAbilities.name: Bane Shield
coreAbilities.description: A baneful aura surrounds you for 10 seconds, lashing out for 150 Spirit damage at any enemies who hit you. Targets can only be damaged once every two seconds. If you have an active Aura of Corruption, you surround group members within 50 feet with a barrier, absorbing up to 937 damage over 10 seconds.

paths.name: Path of Discord
paths.description: A mastery path focused on magical attacks and disruption

ability.name: Siphoned Energy
ability.description: Any time you disrupt a spell, you will regain 157 health, and your movement speed will be increased by 30% for 5 seconds.

ability.name: Discordant Turbulence
ability.note: May only use three Chaotic Auras at a time
ability.description: The power of the Warp melds with the mind of your enemies, causing healing on any foes within 25 feet to be 25% less effective.

ability.name: Tainted Wound
ability.description: If an enemy is directly healed while suffering from your Seeping Wound, the healer will suffer 498 damage.

ability.name: Quake
ability.description: You shake the very earth, dealing 217 Spirit damage to all opponents within 40 feet in front of you, staggering everyone for up to 4 seconds, preventing all actions unless they are damaged. The duration of Quake is increased by 0.5 seconds for each active Aura of Discord.

ability.name: Embrace the Winds
ability.description: All healing used on you becomes 15% more effective.

ability.name: Tzeentch's Reflection
ability.description:
You increase your disrupt chance by 25% for 10 seconds. During this time, any spell you disrupt will silence its caster for 3 seconds.
Group members within 100 feet become surrounded by a magical barrier absorbing 1162 damage from magic abilities for 10 seconds. When the barrier fades, allies are healed for 337 health for each active Aura of Discord.

ability.name: Shatter Faith
ability.description: A thunderous curse shatters the air, inflicting 1800 damage to all targets within 25 feet and dispelling a blessing.

coreAbilities.name: Seeping Wound
coreAbilities.description: Your blade churns with Spiritual energies and will Cripple your target, inflicting 369 damage over 9 seconds.

coreAbilities.name: Ravage
coreAbilities.description: You channel the fell powers of the warp into your blade unleashing a devastating strike that does 209 Spiritual damage.

coreAbilities.name: Discordant Instability
coreAbilities.note: May only use three Chaotic Auras at a time
coreAbilities.description: You tear at the fabric of reality, warping the world around you. Enemies within 25 feet will have all their resistances reduced by 120. During this time, groupmates within 100 feet have all their resistances increased by 240.

coreAbilities.name: Discordant Fluctuation
coreAbilities.note: May only use three Chaotic Auras at a time
coreAbilities.description: The power of the Warp fluctuates violently around you and your allies within 100 feet. Enemies that dare to use offensive magical abilities against a groupmate in this radius will be hit with a magical backlash, causing them 348 Spirit damage. Targets can only be damaged once every two seconds.

coreAbilities.name: Blast Wave
coreAbilities.description: A great burst of corrupted winds tears at all targets within 20 feet, inflicting 495 Spirit damage over 15 seconds . If you have an active Aura of Discord, lower the Wounds of affected enemies by 100 for 20 seconds.

coreAbilities.name: Touch of Palsy
coreAbilities.description: You inflict 134 damage on the target. Target's legs become brittle for 10 seconds, causing them to suffer 112 Spirit damage for every half second they are moving.

coreAbilities.name: Deflect Oil
coreAbilities.description: 50% reduction in damage taken by Oil siege engines. You will also protect two other group mates within 30 feet. Only one effect of this type may be on a player at a time.

coreAbilities.name: Modify War Engine
coreAbilities.description: You shield the Ram absorbing 1500 damage over the next 30 seconds.

coreAbilities.name: Bulwark
coreAbilities.description: Repairs a friendly keep door for 5% of its total health over 15 seconds.

coreAbilities.name: Flee
coreAbilities.description: You run away from the battle in a mad panic, increasing your run speed by 30% for 10 seconds.  You immediately lose all of your action points, any career mechanic points, and your Morale will begin to drop, and you will not begin to regain action points until 10 seconds have passed.

coreAbilities.name: Throwing Axe
coreAbilities.description: A basic throwing attack that inflicts 81 damage. Has a chance to deal 680 damage to a severely wounded target if you are behind them.

coreAbilities.name: Guard
coreAbilities.description:
You defend one of your groupmates and try to take attacks meant for them.  As long as you are within 30 feet of them, any damage that they suffer will be split evenly between the two of you, and 35% of all hate that they cause will be redirected to you. 

Damage received from this ability can be blocked or parried, unless the original attack was undefendable.

coreAbilities.name: Taunt
coreAbilities.description:
You enrage your opponent, interrupting any currently building abilities and increasing their hate towards you. While taunted your opponent will take 30% more damage from your attacks. This effect will fade after 15 seconds or after your opponent has hit you 3 times.
Does not affect damage procs.

coreAbilities.name: Demolishing Strike
coreAbilities.description: A powerful melee attack that reduces  your target's armor by 1056 and deals 900 damage over 15 seconds

coreAbilities.name: Warped Flesh
coreAbilities.description:
Any time you are attacked, there is a 25% chance that you will absorb up to 375 damage.
This effect will not trigger more than once every 3 seconds.

coreAbilities.name: Hold The Line!
coreAbilities.description:
You focus your defenses against enemy fire, increasing your chances to dodge and disrupt by 45% for 12 seconds.  You will also defend all allies behind you, up to 50 feet away, increasing their chances to dodge and disrupt by 15% as long as they remain at your back.  Allies may have this effect stacked on them up to 3 times.
This effect will end if you break your concentration, or run out of action points.

coreAbilities.name: Juggernaut
coreAbilities.description: You become filled with unstoppable power, removing all snaring, rooting, silencing, and disarming effects. For the next 5 seconds, roots and snares will have no effect on you.

coreAbilities.name: Shield Wall
coreAbilities.description: For the next 10 seconds, your chance to block is almost guaranteed.

coreAbilities.name: Focused Offense
coreAbilities.description:
You deal 15% more damage and all enemy monsters will hate you 15% less than normal, but your armor is reduced by 33%.
Does not affect damage procs.

coreAbilities.name: Sever Blessing
coreAbilities.description: You sever one Blessing from your enemy and inflict 134 damage

coreAbilities.name: Rugged
coreAbilities.description: Increases Toughness by 160.

coreAbilities.name: Champion's Challenge
coreAbilities.description:
Both you and your target are held tightly in place for 10 seconds, and neither one of you can move.
This effect cannot be dispelled or broken.

coreAbilities.name: Challenge
coreAbilities.description: You challenge all opponents in front of you, forcing monsters to attack you. While challenged, your opponents will deal only 70% damage to everyone other than you for 7 seconds.

coreAbilities.name: Tzeentch's Warding
coreAbilities.description: Increases your Elemental resistance by 252.

coreAbilities.name: Petrify
coreAbilities.description: The land around you warps and changes, encasing up to 4 nearby opponents in hardened stone. Effected opponents are rooted for 5 seconds and cannot move. Rooted targets have a 50% chance to break free when they suffer damage.

coreAbilities.name: Raze
coreAbilities.description: You repeatedly attack all enemies in a line in front of you, inflicting 300 damage every second  for 3 seconds, up to 65 feet away, for as long as you maintain your concentration.

coreAbilities.name: Flawless Armor
coreAbilities.description: Reduces the chance that an enemy will critically hit you by 10%.

coreAbilities.name: Backlash
coreAbilities.description: Any time you are attacked, there is a 25% chance that you will lash out for 370 Elemental damage over 5 seconds to anyone who hits you.

coreAbilities.name: Distracting Bellow
coreAbilities.description: A loud shout that startles your target and all enemies within 25 feet of them, reducing their damage to 60% for 7 seconds.

coreAbilities.name: Menace
coreAbilities.description: Enemy monsters will hate you 100% more than normal on all attacks.

coreAbilities.name: Quickened Discord
coreAbilities.description: Reduces Blast Wave's cooldown time by 5 seconds and Touch Of Palsy's cooldown time by 10 seconds.

coreAbilities.name: Inevitable Changing
coreAbilities.description: A strong melee attack that deals 600 damage and restores 250 of your AP.

coreAbilities.name: Unstoppable Juggernaut
coreAbilities.description: Juggernaut's cooldown is reduced to 40 seconds.

coreAbilities.name: Critical Suppression
coreAbilities.description: Suppression will now also reduce the victim's chances to defend against attacks by 10% for 10 seconds.

coreAbilities.name: Tzeentch's Amplification
coreAbilities.description: For 15 seconds, Tzeentch amplifies the effects of all heals cast on you by 300%.

coreAbilities.name: Piercing Repel
coreAbilities.description: Repel will now apply a buff on you that will reduce the armor penetration of all attackers by  10% for 10 seconds.

coreAbilities.name: Hastened Dismissal
coreAbilities.description: Reduces the cooldown of Repel by 50%. If wielding a Great Weapon, Repel additionally snares the target by 40% for 5 seconds.

coreAbilities.name: Impenetrable Armor
coreAbilities.description: You are briefly covered with an impenetrable set of scales. For the next 20 seconds, up to 7200 damage will be absorbed.

coreAbilities.name: Power from the Gods
coreAbilities.description: Your auras now restore 5 action points per second for each of your active auras.

coreAbilities.name: Destined For Victory
coreAbilities.description: Any time you block an attack, you gain 250 points of Morale. Tactic can not trigger more than once every 10 seconds.

coreAbilities.name: Immaculate Defense
coreAbilities.description: An impressive display of defense which reduces incoming damage by 75% for both you and all group members within 100 feet of you for 10 seconds.
